# vendor/ — provenance of the vendored dependency closure

TooieRecomp is **standalone**: everything it compiles or runs from other projects lives in this repository as regular files
(`lib/`, `decomp/`, `assets/` [native UI typography fonts, styling and icons only; zero game assets], `recompcontrollerdb.txt`, `tools/wheelhouse/`). There are no submodules, gitlinks, sibling checkouts,
`third_party/` caches or downloads in a normal build. This directory records *where each byte came from*; it is not read by the build.

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `UPSTREAMS.tsv` | every vendored upstream: URL, pinned commit, file/byte counts, licence files (sha256), licence-text heuristic, licence status, integrated patches |
| `patches-applied/`, `patches-superseded/`, `patches-local/` | the 17 historical patches already integrated in `lib/` (+ 4 superseded variants, kept for history) and the one local seam (`rt64-use-host-sdl2-target`). **Provenance only: no script applies them.** `ORDER.tsv` = order, sha256, base commit. Verified via `tools/vendor_verify.sh --reverse-check` (all 18 reverse-applied cleanly) |
| `DERIVED-FILES.tsv` | Tooie app files sharing a path with BanjoRecomp@ec859632 (GPL-3.0) and whether they are byte-identical or modified |
| `BINARIES.tsv` | sha256-pinned allowlist of third-party prebuilt binaries inside `lib/` (DXC, SDL2/FreeType Windows x64). Anything else ELF/PE/ar fails `tools/vendor_verify.sh` |
| `EXCLUDES.txt` | what was deliberately not vendored (includes rule `(^\|/)\.gitrepo$` resolving F5) |
| `provenance/` | informational upstream subrepo/metadata records (e.g. `decomp-ultralib-asm_differ-gitrepo.origin.txt` for asm_differ) |
| `MANIFEST.sha256`, `MODES.tsv` | byte-exact manifest (8266 files, 118 executable files) + exec bits of the vendored trees (`tools/vendor_verify.sh`, regenerated by `tools/vendor_manifest.sh`) |
| `licenses/` | licence texts that have no home inside a vendored tree (BanjoRecomp `COPYING`, GPLv3) |

## Honest limits
* Licence identification here is a **byte match of the licence files that exist upstream** — not legal clearance. `UNKNOWN` / `UNVERIFIED`
  rows (RecompFrontend root, DXC binaries, decomp, ultralib, font/screenshot rights) stay open owner decisions; no project licence is invented
  and no authorship is claimed for upstream code. Upstream names, headers and licence files are preserved untouched.
* Content was exported once (2026-10-21) from a clean tree = upstream pin + the integrated patches, **not** from the older dirty sibling checkouts.
* F5 resolution: nested `.gitrepo` metadata in `decomp/lib/ultralib/tools/asm_differ` was removed from the tree and source archive; origin commit details are preserved in `vendor/provenance/decomp-ultralib-asm_differ-gitrepo.origin.txt`. Manifest reflects 8266 files.
* F1 resolution: Linux packaging tool (`tools/package_linux.sh`) resolves `ldconfig` via `/sbin/ldconfig` under restricted sandbox PATH (0 warnings).
* Not vendored and never committed: Banjo-Tooie ROM (`Banjo-Tooie (USA).z64`, MD5 `40e98faa24ac3ebe1d25cb5e5ddf49e4`, SHA-1 `af1a89e12b638b8d82cc4c085c8e01d4cba03fb3`), decompressed ROM image (`35098224` bytes, SHA-1 `af479771ff5e91ce3732f3d84146614ab71d8d79`), extracted game assets, saves, generated `RecompiledFuncs/`, the legacy IDO/gcc/binutils kit
  (hash-pinned in `tools/toolchain.lock`, installed by `tools/toolchain_kit.sh`).
